## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits (`type: summary`, ≤ 72 chars) — it becomes the squash commit on `master`.
- [ ] Rebased on current `master` and `just gate` is green on the rebased head.
- [ ] No local paths, machine names, or other private details in the diff or description.
- [ ] Every review comment is addressed — fixed or answered.
- [ ] Generated files and lockfiles were regenerated, not hand-merged (if applicable).
